scope: Sensor CLI and shared scheduled-job no-op prevention
covered_contracts: Empty or conflicting operations fail before database configuration is loaded
Incomplete sensor/value and date/time combinations fail before database access
CSV, single-reading, list, and calibration commands retain their dispatch behavior
The shared sensors JobSpec rejects the missing recurring source contract before subprocess launch
Module help and missing-input errors do not require SOPS decryption
runtime_scope: No database, sensor provider, ClickHouse service, Prefect deployment, or schedule was accessed or changed.
remaining_gate: Choose and implement an explicit recurring sensor source contract before enabling the hourly sensor schedule.
